text:
vp-eng: Thanks again for the all-hands everyone. Quick follow-up on the runtime roadmap — two short asks: clarify our throughput SLO targets for hosted, and how batching/cache/kernel rollouts will map to canary windows and rollback triggers. @maya-eng-runtime @alex-eng-sre

maya-eng-runtime: Short version: target is p95 token-latency <200ms for hosted standard tier (99.9% of traffic). Batching + KV cache changes will be opt-in per model-variant and rolled out staged with traffic-weighted canaries. Proposed rollout steps: 10% -> 30% -> 100%, with health gates at each step.

alex-eng-sre: Ops guardrails: automatic rollback if p95 increases >10% relative to baseline or error rate spikes >0.5% in any 1h window. We'll run canaries for at least one full high-traffic cycle (24h) per step, but traffic-weighted steps let us accelerate if stable. We'll also keep a shadow lane for correctness diffs.

jamal-ml: For kernel changes (attn-microkernel-v2) expect perf gains on long sequences (2x in some cases); there are small regressions possible on short sequences due to different prefetch. ETA: canary next week, broader rollout ~6 weeks pending canary. We should flag model families where seq-dist differs significantly.

sophia-product: Will Dedicated/reserved customers be able to opt out / pin old variants? Need this clarified so account teams can advise. Also need a short, customer-facing blurb for Console.

maya-eng-runtime: Yes — Dedicated customers can pin a variant per-route. We'll expose a per-route toggle in Console and an API flag. Example rollout policy config for docs: 
```json
{
  "rollout_steps": [10, 30, 100],
  "step_duration_hours": 48,
  "rollback_thresholds": {"p95_pct": 10, "error_rate_pct": 0.5}
}
```

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: attn-microkernel-v2-canary -> 2025-06-12 03:00 UTC :rocket: (canary window 72h)

vp-eng: Great — action items: eng-runtime to publish rollout doc + example policies by EOD Thu, eng-sre to add auto-rollback monitor and alert runbook, product to draft Dedicated opt-out UX and console blurb. Ping me when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
